en.headline: Firefighters dismantle precarious scaffolding outside Jordan building
en.dek: A 1.5-metre scaffold erected for air-conditioner works shifted and hung dangerously overnight; one traffic lane was closed during the removal.
body: Firefighters used an aerial ladder early on Tuesday to dismantle a precarious scaffolding structure outside Pak On Building on Austin Road in Jordan. The structure, measuring about 1.5 metres by 1.5 metres, had been erected on the first-floor exterior for the replacement of a split-type air conditioner.

A tenant noticed the scaffold had shifted and was hanging dangerously after midnight and alerted the landlord, who called the police. Officers and firefighters arrived around 12:23 a.m. One lane towards Hung Hom was temporarily closed while the work was carried out. No one was injured.
It is understood the scaffold had been put up on Monday morning and left in place after the air-conditioner work. A passing vehicle may have struck the supporting frame, causing the shift.

zh.headline: 佐敦大廈棚架搖搖欲墜 消防升雲梯拆除
zh.dek: 柯士甸道百安大廈一樓冷氣工程棚架移位懸空，消防凌晨出動雲梯移除，往紅磡方向一度封閉一條行車線。
body: 消防人員今日凌晨在佐敦柯士甸道105號百安大廈外，以雲梯拆除一個搖搖欲墜的棚架。該棚架約1.5米乘1.5米，原本搭建於一樓外牆，供更換分體式冷氣機使用。
單位租客發現棚架移位後通知業主，業主於午夜後報警。警方及消防約凌晨12時23分到場，期間往紅磡方向其中一條行車線一度封閉。事件中無人受傷。
據悉棚架於周一早上搭建，冷氣機工程後仍未拆除，初步懷疑有車輛駛經時撞到支撐架，導致棚架移位。
